# Incident Report — Game Server Outage, 2026-06-02

## Summary
The dedicated game server was down for **35 minutes 49 seconds (35.82 min)** on June 2, 2026,
from **03:17:42** to **03:53:31**, because the `/data` disk filled up. June availability was
**99.9171%**, which **meets** the 99.9% monthly SLO (budget: 43.2 min; used: 35.82 min).

## Timeline (times from server logs, local)
| Time | Event |
|---|---|
| 06-02 03:10:02 | WARN: disk `/data` at 97% usage (3.1 GB free) |
| 06-02 03:11:51 | Last successful autosave |
| 06-02 **03:17:42** | **First `SaveGame failed ... No space left on device` — incident start** (per README, down = first save error → "server ready") |
| 06-02 03:18:00 | Second failed save |
| 06-02 03:18:05 | FATAL watchdog: server unresponsive for 20 s, restarting |
| 06-02 03:18:31–03:52:20 | 38 watchdog restart attempts, all exiting code 137 (killed) — restarts could not complete while `/data` was full |
| 06-02 03:52:10 | Backup rotation freed **38.2 GB** on `/data` |
| 06-02 **03:53:31** | `server ready, accepting players` — incident end |

## Root Cause
`/data` ran out of free space. The disk was already at 97% (only 3.1 GB free) before the
incident; autosave writes exhausted the remainder, so game saves failed with ENOSPC. The
server hung, and the watchdog's kill/restart cycle (exit code 137) could not bring it back
while the disk stayed full. Service resumed automatically only after the scheduled backup
rotation at 03:52:10 reclaimed 38.2 GB.

**Trigger:** disk space exhaustion on `/data`.
**Aggravating factor:** no alerting/action on the 97% disk warning; restart loop had no disk-space check.

## Availability / SLO
- June 2026 = 30 days = 43,200 minutes.
- Downtime = 35.8167 minutes.
- Availability = (43,200 − 35.8167) / 43,200 = **99.9171%**.
- SLO 99.9% allows 43.2 minutes downtime → **SLO met** (7.4 minutes of margin remaining).

## Notes on data examined
- Logs cover 2026-06-01 → 2026-06-03; README confirms only one incident.
- The ERROR line on June 1 (09:12:40, "RCON auth failed ... bad password") is an unrelated
  authentication failure — the server remained up and is not part of this incident.

## Recommended follow-ups
1. Alert on `/data` usage ≥ 85% and page before 95%; today's 97% warning went unactioned.
2. Make backup rotation more aggressive/frequent or expand `/data`; 3.1 GB free is below one autosave cycle's headroom.
3. Have the watchdog detect ENOSPC / full-disk state and surface it, instead of blindly restarting (38 futile attempts over 34 minutes).
4. Consider graceful degradation: keep players in-session if autosaves fail transiently, rather than hanging.
